title: Your Significance and Purpose Within the Body of Christ
titleZh: 你在基督身體裡的重要性與目的
summaryZh: 聚集時彼此鼓勵，並付代價教導孩子看重神所看重的事。
lines: One of my favorite things that we do— a few years ago, I was with Eric and Nate from the leadership, and I think a few churches, Brian Blank from Little Country.
幾年前，我和領導團隊的 Eric、Nate，還有我想是幾間教會的人，以及 Little Country 的 Brian Blank，一起做了一件我很喜歡的事。
These are all such wonderful people and wonderful churches.
這些人和教會都非常美好。
And we have such a meaningful relationship with them.
我們和他們的關係也很有意義。
But they thought we should start gathering together on Good Friday.
但他們覺得我們應該開始在耶穌受難日聚集在一起。
So some of you remember how many years ago they started getting together.
所以你們有些人還記得，他們是幾年前開始聚在一起的。
And within two or three years, about 80 to 110 churches in Redding started getting involved, wanting to be a part of that Good Friday service.
兩三年之內，雷丁大約有八十到一百一十間教會開始參與，都想成為那場耶穌受難日聚會的一分子。
It was just incredible to be a part of that.
能參與其中，真是太不可思議了。
And I remember when I first had the opportunity to mention this here, I addressed all the parents of young children.
我記得第一次有機會在這裡提到這件事時，我是對所有有年幼孩子的父母說的。
I know that when we gather together, the last thing we want is to hold a crying child during the service, when we try to worship together as a community.
我知道我們聚在一起時，最不想做的就是在聚會中抱著哭鬧的孩子，而我們也正想一起作為群體敬拜。
But I encouraged them to do this, and I want you to hear the reason.
但我鼓勵他們這麼做，我也想讓你們聽聽原因。
I encourage all our people: bring your children no matter what.
我鼓勵我們所有人：無論如何，都要帶孩子來。
Even if they misbehave, even if they are naughty, even if they cry.
即使他們不守規矩，即使他們調皮，即使他們哭鬧，也要帶來。
I want them to be taught values.
我希望他們學會看重哪些價值。
I want them to be taught what is important.
我希望他們知道什麼是重要的。
Our children know when we make decisions that cost us dearly.
我們的孩子知道，有些決定會讓我們付出很大的代價。
They see when we make decisions, repeat them with fidelity, and they see that it is worth our effort.
他們看見我們作出決定、忠心地持守，也看見這值得我們付出心力。
This is one of the most important lessons you will teach your children when you show them what is truly valuable.
當你讓孩子看見什麼才真正有價值時，這就是你會教給他們最重要的功課之一。
We have a generation that is growing up to know that there is something unique and special about regular gatherings in the house of God, from the temple to every home.
我們正在培育新一代，讓他們知道，無論是在聖殿還是每個家中，定期在神的殿聚集都有獨特而特別的意義。
It says here, in verse 24, "Let us watch over one another to encourage love and good works."
這裡第 24 節說：「又要彼此相顧，激發愛心，勉勵行善。」
This is actually a description of a joint gathering.
這其實是在描述一場共同聚集。
This is what you want to be a force for.
這就是你們要一起成為推動力量的事。
I understand, sometimes we are the ones getting shot at, and we come together because we hope someone will notice our pain.
我明白，有時候我們就是挨打的人；我們聚在一起，是因為希望有人會注意到我們的痛苦。
I understand this, and I think it's important.
我理解這一點，也認為這很重要。
But sometimes the most important thing you can do is to come forward with a word of promise, even in your pain.
但有時候，即使你正身處痛苦之中，最重要的事是挺身而出，帶著一句應許的話來鼓勵人。
I have had moments when the Lord has given me a very specific word, and I have felt I must share it.
有些時候，主給了我非常明確的話，我覺得自己必須分享出去。
I'm not going to keep it for myself; it's such a good word that I have to give it to someone else.
我不會把它留給自己；這是如此美好的話，我必須把它給別人。
And in doing this for many years, I see people whose lives have literally been changed by a word that was given at a certain time and first came to me.
多年來這樣做，我看見有些人的生命真的因著一句話而改變；那句話是在某個時刻賜下，並且最先臨到我。
Some of you have received calls from friends.
你們有些人接過朋友打來的電話。
They did different things to encourage you, to strengthen you in your faith.
他們用不同的方式鼓勵你，在信心上堅固你。
They made you promises when you were in crisis.
你身陷危機時，他們向你作出應許。
你當時遇到很大的財務困難。
You were in a state of health crisis.
你當時正面臨健康危機。
They told you that by the wounds of Jesus you were healed.
他們告訴你：「因祂受的鞭傷，你們得了醫治。」
They armed you with words of encouragement so you could pass them on to others.
他們用鼓勵的話裝備你，好讓你也能把這些話傳給別人。
And something profound happens in the life of a church family that learns to live this way.
一個學會如此生活的教會大家庭，生命中會發生深刻的事。
So Paul says, "When you come together, I would say in my own way, come with the intention of speaking into the lives of others in a way that will strengthen and encourage them."
所以保羅說：「你們聚在一起時，我會用自己的方式這樣說：要帶著一個心志，用能堅固並鼓勵別人的方式，向他們的生命說話。」
